name: Once upon an Isekai
source:
After sudden darkness, you find yourself kneeling in front of a King?! And he orders you to bring him Snow White's heart! What will you do?

[From [url=https://calnite.itch.io/once-upon-an-isekai]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
突如其来的黑暗之后，你发现自己跪在国王面前？！他命令你把白雪公主的心带给他！你会怎么做？

[来自[url=https://calnite.itch.io/once-upon-an-isekai]itch.io[/url]]
